dog.description_text: Daisy Daisy 🐾 2-year-old Female | 54 lbs | Short, Stocky Bully Mix Daisy is a happy-go-lucky girl with a playful, loving personality! She is incredibly sweet and would make a wonderful companion. ✅ Good with other dogs ✅ Doesn’t mind cats, though she may occasionally chase them out of curiosity ✅ Crate trained ✅ Potty trained ✅ Very playful and affectionate If you’re looking for a fun, loyal, and loving best friend, Daisy could be the perfect match!
